get.description: Fetches the Look Ahead report which provides future assignments and availability details for People within a specified Group. To span all Groups in the company, use `"all"` in place of `{group_id}`.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier for the company. This parameter accepts both formats:
- **Recommended**: Procore company ID (integer) - Use this for new integrations
- Legacy: LaborChart UUID format (uuid string) - Supported for backward compatibility

A proxy layer automatically handles both formats, but using the Procore company ID is preferred for consistency with other Procore APIs.

parameters.name: group_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the group

parameters.name: jobTitleIds
parameters.description: An array of UUIDs representing the Job Titles to include in the report. People with Job Titles not in this list will be excluded.

parameters.name: assignmentCount
parameters.description: The number of future assignments to return per person.

parameters.name: projectName
parameters.description: Whether to include the project name for each assignment.

parameters.name: project_number
parameters.description: Filters items by their exact project number. The query performs an exact match. Example usage: `/v2/companies/{company_id}/...?project_number=BR-2024`

parameters.name: assignmentStart
parameters.description: Whether to include the assignment start date.

parameters.name: assignmentEnd
parameters.description: Whether to include the assignment end date.

parameters.name: availableAfterDate
parameters.description: Whether to include the last day a person is assigned in the future.

parameters.name: employee_number
parameters.description: Filter results by the exact employee number of the Person.

parameters.name: jobTitle
parameters.description: Whether to include the person's Job Title.

parameters.name: assignmentDuration
parameters.description: Whether to include a calculated duration for each assignment.

schema.description: Returns an array of Look Ahead report objects.

items.description: Represents a single Person's Look Ahead report data, including assignments and availability.

available_after.description: The last day in the future that this person is assigned.

employee_number.description: The employee number of the person.

name.description: The first and last name of the person.

job_title_id.description: The UUID of the Job Title assigned to this person.

job_title_name.description: The name of the Job Title assigned to this person.

assignments.description: List of upcoming assignments for this person.

project_name.description: The name of the assigned project.

project_number.description: The number of the assigned project.

start_day.description: The start date of the assignment.

end_day.description: The end date of the assignment.

duration.description: The duration of the assignment in a readable format.

error.description: If you receive a 401 error, please ensure you are following the OAuth 2.0 guidelines outlined at https://developers.procore.com/documentation/introduction and verify you can successfully call the /me endpoint using your access token. Additionally, the user associated with that token must be added as a user in the Workforce Planning People List for the corresponding company.

get.description: Retrieves a list of People who have Tags that are either expired or within their expiration warning period. This report is executed under the context of the specified Group ID. If you want to fetch data for all groups in a company, use `all` in place of `{group_id}`.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description:
Unique identifier for the company. This parameter accepts both formats:
- **Recommended**: Procore company ID (integer) - Use this for new integrations
- Legacy: LaborChart UUID format (uuid string) - Supported for backward compatibility

A proxy layer automatically handles both formats, but using the Procore company ID is preferred for consistency with other Procore APIs.

parameters.name: group_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the group

parameters.name: tagIds
parameters.description: Array of UUIDs representing the Tags you want to filter the report by. If not provided, the report includes all Tags available to the Group.

parameters.name: warningTags
parameters.description: Determines whether Tags within their expiration warning period should be included in the report. If set to `false`, only expired Tags will be included.

parameters.name: employee_number
parameters.description: Filter results by the exact employee number of the Person.

parameters.name: jobTitle
parameters.description: Whether to include the person's Job Title.

schema.description: Returns an array of People with Tags requiring action.

items.description: Object representing a Person with a Tag requiring action.

first.description: The first name of the Person.

last.description: The last name of the Person.

employee_number.description: The employee number of the Person.

job_title.description: The Job Title of the Person.

tag.description: Details about the Tag requiring action.

expr_date.description: Expiration date of the Tag in Unix timestamp format.

error.description: If you receive a 401 error, please ensure you are following the OAuth 2.0 guidelines outlined at https://developers.procore.com/documentation/introduction and verify you can successfully call the /me endpoint using your access token. Additionally, the user associated with that token must be added as a user in the Workforce Planning People List for the corresponding company.
